banner.title: We Value Your Privacy
description: We use essential cookies and similar technologies to operate our website. With your consent, we also use optional technologies to analyze website usage and measure advertising performance.
You can accept all optional cookies, reject them, or manage your preferences at any time.

settings.title: Cookie Settings
description: Manage your preferences for optional cookies and similar technologies.
You can change or withdraw your consent at any time.

essential.name: Essential Cookies
essential.description: These technologies are necessary for essential website functions, such as authentication, security, consent management, and live chat support, including monitoring of the chat service.

optional.name: Analytics Cookies
optional.description: These technologies help us understand how visitors use our website and measure website performance.

optional.name: Marketing Cookies
optional.description: These technologies help measure advertising performance and support personalized advertising activities.

items.name: ch-session-248070
items.purpose: Maintains and manages the live chat session.

items.name: ch-veil-id
items.purpose: Identifies returning chat visitors to keep previous conversations available.

items.name: _dd_s_v2
items.purpose: Monitors errors and performance of the live chat widget. Set by Channel Talk and cannot be turned off separately from live chat.

items.name: _ga
items.purpose: Distinguishes visitors to help measure website usage.
items.expiration: Up to 2 years (browsers may set a shorter limit)

items.name: _ga_NQPD9VE63R
items.purpose: Stores session information for website analytics.
items.expiration: Up to 2 years (browsers may set a shorter limit)

items.name: medidakos_ga_client_id
items.purpose: Keeps your Google Analytics visitor ID in this tab so inquiries can be linked to website analytics.
items.expiration: Until the browser tab is closed

items.name: medidakos_utm_params
items.purpose: Keeps the campaign (UTM) parameters of your landing page in this tab so inquiries can be attributed to the campaign.
items.expiration: Until the browser tab is closed

items.name: _fbp
items.purpose: Helps identify browsers for advertising measurement.

items.name: _fbc
items.purpose: Stores the Meta ad click ID, only when you arrive from a Meta ad.

items.name: lastExternalReferrer
items.purpose: Records the last external website that referred you, for advertising measurement.
items.expiration: Until deleted; removed when you withdraw consent

items.name: lastExternalReferrerTime
items.purpose: Records when that last external referral happened.
items.expiration: Until deleted; removed when you withdraw consent

items.name: _gcl_aw
items.purpose: Stores the Google Ads click ID to measure ad conversions, only when you arrive from a Google ad and both Analytics and Marketing are allowed.

items.name: _gcl_gs
items.purpose: Stores related Google Ads click information, only when you arrive from a Google ad and both Analytics and Marketing are allowed.

items.name: _gcl_ls
items.purpose: Keeps Google Ads click information for conversion measurement, only when you arrive from a Google ad and both Analytics and Marketing are allowed.
items.expiration: Until deleted; removed when you withdraw Analytics or Marketing consent

notice.gpcNotice: Your browser's Global Privacy Control signal is honored, so marketing technologies stay off.
